clue.text: Together, as worker being dealt with

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as on a farm or a ship
a matter in hand is one being dealt with now

explanation.surface: A labourer is said to be handled together with something, as a single matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people walking hand in hand are together, so the idiom means jointly or closely allied.

clue.text: Detest pillbox, for example, on top of embankment

parts.note: a pillbox is a small round brimless hat

indicators.note: in a down entry the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone loathes the concrete wartime pillbox perched on top of an embankment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pillbox' suggests a military bunker on a bank; here it is a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to detest something is to loathe it intensely.

clue.text: Really showing approval about current king climbing

indicators.note: the word for showing approval goes around the other letters

parts.note: nodding the head shows agreement

indicators.note: in a down entry the two letters go upwards, so they read in reverse

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Someone nods along about a monarch's present rise to power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns IK into KI, which 'about' places inside NODDING.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the phrase is an exclamation meaning honestly or truly, I'm serious.

clue.text: Very happy, giddy teens online, tackling me

indicators.note: the scrambled letters take hold of the small word, wrapping round it
giddy means dizzy and whirling, so these letters spin into a new order

explanation.surface: Giddy teenagers on the internet gang up on the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giddy' rearranges TEENS ONLINE into INONESELENT, and 'tackling' sets ME inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: being in a situation that suits you perfectly makes you content and comfortable.

clue.text: Ghastly house I'd renovated

indicators.note: a renovated building is made over, so these letters are rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone renovated a ghastly house.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something hideous is horribly ugly or revolting.

clue.text: A name in Conservative party supporting new and old? That's not possible

indicators.note: in a down entry the supporting part sits below the letters for new and old
the article and name letter go inside the Conservative party letters

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A Tory gathering backs both new and old members; the response is a flat refusal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a pidgin-style phrase used to refuse a request as impossible.

clue.text: Indefinite number leaving stadium in locality

indicators.note: the number departs from the stadium, so its letter is taken out

parts.note: an arena is a sports stadium
N stands for an unspecified number in maths

explanation.surface: A crowd of uncertain size streams out of a stadium into the neighbourhood.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an area is a district or neighbourhood.

clue.text: Noisy argument with daughter ending in acrimony

parts.note: a row is a quarrel

indicators.note: the final letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A loud quarrel with a daughter ends in bitterness.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: rowdy means rough, loud and disorderly.

clue.text: D'Arcy's character?

parts.note: the name D'Arcy's contains two punctuation marks of this kind; a character is a printed symbol, not someone's personality

explanation.walkthrough: 'D'Arcy' calls up Mr Darcy's personality in Pride and Prejudice, but the character meant is a typographical one: the mark printed twice in the clue itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A punctuation mark marking possession or omitted letters is a printed symbol, so a typographic character.

clue.text: Capital of Kentucky put in as well

indicators.note: the state's abbreviation is placed inside the word for also

parts.note: too means as well, also
KY is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Kentucky

explanation.surface: Kentucky's capital is apparently added in too, as an afterthought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital of Kentucky' looks like one phrase asking for Frankfort; 'Capital' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the city is the capital of Japan.

clue.text: Patch up women's house in TV series

parts.note: to doctor something is to repair it roughly
W is the abbreviation for women, as on toilet doors

explanation.surface: A TV programme in which a women's refuge is repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the long-running BBC science-fiction drama about a time-travelling alien.

clue.text: Where watch may display time, seemingly

definitions.meaning: a clock's hands show the hour on its dial

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a dial shows the hour there; idiomatically the phrase means judging from how things appear.

clue.text: Blow over pop off having drink

parts.note: to pop off is slang for to die
to down a drink is to swallow it in one

explanation.surface: Someone keels over and dies after knocking back a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a storm or scandal that blows over subsides and fades away.

clue.text: Appointment to meet son, tense after test

indicators.note: the son and tense letters come after the word for test

parts.note: to try something is to test it
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A father arranges to meet his son, anxious after an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tryst is a secret rendezvous, usually between lovers.

clue.text: Old hit carols I broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast seed is scattered widely, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A DJ plays golden-oldie Christmas hits on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old hit' looks like one phrase, but 'Old' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: belonging to past times, relating to history.

clue.text: Aloofness shown in public, in essence

indicators.note: the letters are on display inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Coldness of manner is, in essence, what someone displays in public.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative sense: frostiness of manner is a cold, distant reserve toward others.

clue.text: Daughter of Lear, stuffing two ducks, needed to find herb

indicators.note: the daughter's name is packed between the two letters, like stuffing in a bird

parts.note: a duck is a score of nought in cricket, so two ducks are two Os
Regan is one of King Lear's daughters in Shakespeare's play

explanation.surface: One of Lear's daughters stuffs a pair of ducks and needs a herb for the recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a fragrant culinary plant of the marjoram family used in Italian cooking.

clue.text: Musical passage in film

parts.note: Annie is the stage musical about the orphan Little Orphan Annie
a hall is a corridor or entrance passage

explanation.surface: A musical number turns up in a passage of a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Woody Allen's 1977 romantic comedy starring Diane Keaton.

clue.text: Pair of wrestlers, game couple

parts.note: tag is the children's chasing game
a team can be a pair of animals harnessed together

explanation.surface: Two wrestlers are a sporting couple, game for anything.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrestling duo who take turns in the ring, tagging each other in, form this kind of partnership.

clue.text: Grim, the old lady about to grab taxi

indicators.note: the mother and about letters seize the taxi word between them

parts.note: one's old lady is one's mother, MA
re means about or concerning
a cab is a taxi

explanation.surface: A grim scene: an elderly woman is about to snatch a taxi.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: macabre means gruesome, dwelling on death.

clue.text: Strong check

definitions.meaning: loyal and firm, steadfast in support
to stop a flow, especially of blood from a wound

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means firmly loyal; the verb, also spelt stanch, means to stem bleeding.

clue.text: Conspicuous, foreigner in street

indicators.note: the foreigner is placed inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: an alien is a foreign national

explanation.surface: A foreigner stands out in the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something salient stands out or is most noticeable.

clue.text: Scoundrel's accent, not British

indicators.note: the letter for British is to be left out of the word for accent

parts.note: a brogue is a regional accent, especially Irish

explanation.surface: A villain's way of speaking is not a British one.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Scoundrel is a link meaning 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a rogue is a dishonest rascal or villain.

clue.text: Type in information, extremely reliable

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone keys in data that is utterly dependable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Type in' reads as a keyboard instruction, but 'Type' is a noun meaning kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a genre is a kind or category, especially of art or literature.

clue.text: Old king holding on for Churchill, say

indicators.note: the king's name grips the cricket word inside it

parts.note: Old King Cole is the merry monarch of the nursery rhyme
in cricket the on side is also called the leg side

explanation.surface: A former monarch keeps hold of Winston Churchill, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Churchill' looks like the wartime prime minister, but here it is Churchill College, part of Cambridge University.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Churchill is one of the constituent colleges of Cambridge University.

clue.text: I must not be involved in basic plot

indicators.note: the letter is to stay out of the word, so it is removed

parts.note: plain means simple or basic

explanation.surface: Someone insists on keeping out of a simple scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a plot is a scheme or plan, as in a conspiracy.

clue.text: Police officer with prisoners brought before board

indicators.note: the convicts' word is placed ahead of the word for board

parts.note: cons is slang for convicts
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A policeman brings his prisoners before a disciplinary board.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a constable is the lowest-ranking police officer in Britain.

clue.text: Omit to collect large threshing implement

indicators.note: the word for omit gathers the size letter inside it

parts.note: to fail to do something is to omit it
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Someone forgets to pick up a big tool for threshing grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a wooden tool with a swinging bar used to beat grain from husks.

clue.text: German song told a tale

definitions.meaning: a Romantic art song for voice and piano, such as one by Schubert
to tell a tale is to fib or say something untrue

explanation.definitionFit: One word is the German term for an art song; the other is the past tense of fib.

clue.text: Collapsed on tenth lap in Olympic event

indicators.note: a runner collapsing falls in a heap, so these letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: An athlete collapses on the tenth lap during an Olympic race.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a five-discipline contest of fencing, swimming, riding, shooting and running at the Games.
